independence_basis: Independent Sol high review; auditor did not author the request, SQL, migration runner, or operation plan and performed no database write.

scope.world_schema: infra/world-base/schema.sql and its ordered 01.sql-26.sql parts, exactly as hashed in the request
scope.party_schema: runSpatialV3TargetMigrations and its ordered 001-036 SQL files, exactly as hashed in the request

approval: Fresh schema creation only, after all execution preconditions pass; no existing database may be reused, dropped, or modified.
execution_preconditions: Verify the actual PostgreSQL cluster identity, version, current backup, and existing database row counts before any write.
Verify both v17 database names are absent; stop if either exists.
Verify world_operator, party_operator, and world_reader roles already exist. The world DDL otherwise creates the cluster-wide world_reader role.
Verify the source file hashes, ordered files, request digest, and party chain digest again at execution time.
Complete a dry run of the exact schema sources against disposable empty databases before the managed local-play write.

Verify both newly created databases are empty, correctly owned, and selected explicitly before applying either schema. Apply the world entrypoint in one transaction with ON_ERROR_STOP; apply the party chain through its existing transactional runner without exactAppliedMigration.

Read back 208 world_base tables, world_reader privileges, party applied/newly_applied counts of 36 and execution_mode applied, empty party state, and unchanged row counts in novgorod_world and novgorod_party. Record actual results in a separate execution attestation.
excludes: migration or mutation of existing databases
